claim: A Chicken Coop produces up to 5 Eggs per game day regardless of how many workers are assigned; extra workers collect and clean.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report relayed in the research handoff, issue 10 comment 6405316937. Collection formula 282694 takes about 5.3 simulation seconds per egg; adult chicken config 303909 stores an extraction interval of 60.

notes: Not independently reproduced from the laying logic; the two MaxSpawned=5 spawners under the coop spawn manure, not eggs.
